Our Mission

We Don't Teach Syntax.
We Forge Engineers.

CodesNLogic was founded on a simple truth: The gap between university education and industry demand is widening. We exist to bridge that gap with pure, unadulterated engineering logic.

The Genesis of CNL

Started by a group of Senior Architects from Tier-1 tech firms, CodesNLogic began as a small mentorship program. We noticed that most freshers knew "how to write a loop" but didn't know "how to design a system."

Today, we have evolved into a full-scale Academy and Software Consultancy, having trained over 20,000+ students and helped them land roles in companies like Google, Amazon, and Microsoft.

Our Logic Pillars

First Principles

We break down complex problems to their core elements. No memorization, only understanding.

Production-First

If it can't run in a production environment, we don't teach it. We focus on real-world constraints.
